blurb: Bodies Kneaded offers therapeutic massage treatments focusing on work-related injury, car accident injury, and chronic pain. They provide various massage types including deep tissue, sports injury treatment, prenatal, postnatal, geriatric, and reflexology. The business works with insurance plans and offers special pricing for students, military, and seniors.
extraNote: Non-insurance rates apply for listed massage packages · Auto and work injury treatments billed directly to insurance, usually no out-of-pocket expense · 3810 166th Pl NE Suite 201A, Arlington, WA
